verdict.rationale: First-party docs list subscribable webhook types: Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning, and Report. They also describe payment-event and network-token lifecycle webhooks, plus relayed authorisation webhooks that are configured in the Customer Area and sent to your own servers with a 2000 ms response window. Missing for 10: no evidence of programmatic (API-based) webhook subscription management, no documented signature verification or retry semantics in the pack, no independent or hands-on corroboration.
